subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful embedded `after_compaction` hooks become a supported plugin contract for requesting a deferred reset of their current session?
rationale: The implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but deciding whether external plugins should receive this new session-lifecycle capability and compatibility commitment requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve the scoped contract
options.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, document its availability and guarantees, and require complete live lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Do not add the plugin API and instead implement reset policy inside the owning bundled context or memory integration.

options.title: Pause for broader API design
options.body: Defer this PR and design a general plugin session-management contract separately from compaction hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped contract
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, document its availability and guarantees, and require complete live lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest supplied history signal across compaction hooks, Codex parity, and adjacent plugin/runtime boundaries.
